user.title: Select Danfoss eTRV
user.description: Pick a discovered thermostat to pair.

pair.title: Pair {name}
pair.description: Click Submit, then short-press the button on the thermostat within a minute. Keep this dialog open until pairing completes.

data.pin: PIN set on the thermostat (4 digits)

reauth_confirm.title: PIN rejected by {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The thermostat refused the stored PIN. Enter the PIN set on it.

error.connect_failed: Could not reach the thermostat. Try again.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed: the thermostat did not enter setup mode, or its key could not be read. Submit again and short-press the button.
error.not_connectable: No Bluetooth adapter or proxy can connect to this thermostat. Check it is in range of a connectable adapter or an active ESPHome proxy.

abort.not_supported: Discovered device is not a Danfoss eTRV.

init.title: Danfoss eTRV options
init.description: Set the weekly heating schedule. Each day is a list of comfort periods like `06:00-08:30, 16:30-22:30` (max 3, 30-minute steps). Empty means away temperature all day. The schedule applies while the thermostat is in Auto mode.

data.pin_enabled: Require a PIN on the thermostat

data_description.pin_enabled: Thermostat rejects connections without this PIN. Saved to the thermostat.
data_description.pin: 4 digits. Lost PIN may require a factory reset.

error.invalid_schedule: Could not read the schedule. Use times like `06:00-08:30`, comma-separated, max 3 per day, on 30-minute steps.
error.pin_write_failed: Could not write the PIN to the thermostat. It may be unreachable — try again.
error.write_failed: Could not write the schedule to the thermostat. It may be unreachable — try again.
